body:
**FIX STEP ORDER (advisor vet 633 NOT-READY, 2026-10-24; receipt [2113#issuecomment-6378971747](https://github.com/zwrose/superheroes/pull/2113#issuecomment-6378971747)).** Vet 632's two findings are fixed at `58cacc62` (`e3f0c9c9`) and the advisor confirmed both on macOS. Owed, by the **original builder session only** (`issue-2110-e7688475ac6131f3`); the parked fix leg (`issue-2110-2a0654b830b8ac5d`) stays stood down and pushes nothing:
1. **Bring current with `main`:** a plain `--no-ff` merge of `origin/main` into `claude/issue-2110-nxhfk5`; the one conflict, `plugins/superheroes/TRANSITION.md`, keeps both sides' bullets and sections. No further change to `test_host_model_2110.py` (a fourth rework of that file is out of bounds).
2. **One independent reviewer** outside the anthropic family (codex) reads `da7f67d8..<new head>` (the fix and the merge together); post its raw output on the PR.
3. **Write the review record on the final head** (`review_record.py write`), settling the session-4 Minor ("invalid UTF-8 fixture is never parsed") as `fixed` at `e3f0c9c9` through `carriedChecks`.
4. CI green on the new head; update the PR body in place (also rejoin the build record's dispositions table, which a blank line splits); push fast-forward (never force; no new PR); hand back.

**STATE:** filed 2026-10-23 on the owner's word ("4 b - launch it though": file it, 0.46.0 not held, and launch it; [chat-ruling record](https://github.com/zwrose/superheroes/issues/695#issuecomment-6376543928)). Route: **build-ready** (a repair with a receipt anchor). Launch: cloud, claude-three, at filing. Built as PR #2113 (head `58cacc62`); vet 632 NOT-READY, fixed in `e3f0c9c9` by the original builder (the fix leg launched 2026-10-24 parked unpushed: #2119); vet 633 NOT-READY (no review record on the final head; bring-current with `main` owed, `TRANSITION.md` conflict); fix step returned to the original builder 2026-10-24. Release: **0.46.0 is not held for it**. **Lane: full** (`lane_call.py` floor: full, the session-start hook; and a panel silently missing every Claude reviewer is a quiet failure). **Presentation: nothing to see** (review machinery; the receipt's disclosures change). Size consideration: estimate 40–120 non-test lines (`hooks/session_start.py`, the host-model read before `seat_map.py compose`, `skills/review-code/reference/setup.md`, TRANSITION). Headless: questions go to the advisor as builder notes on this issue.

Anchor (receipt): the consuming project's advisor's field report of 2026-10-23 ("how could the panel not tell the builder's model?") and the advisor's demonstration, logged at https://github.com/zwrose/superheroes/issues/1914#issuecomment-6376455822 and https://github.com/zwrose/superheroes/issues/1914#issuecomment-6376463362: a consuming project's builder env file holds only `export SUPERHEROES_HOST_MODEL=''`; this advisor seat's own env file shows a blank followed by the real model; superheroes #2093's build reported `host-model-unknown`.

What: **the review panel knows the model the session runs on whenever any record of it exists, so it never drops every Claude reviewer for want of a model it could have read.**
- Today `hooks/session_start.py` writes `export SUPERHEROES_HOST_MODEL=<payload model>` on every start event, and an empty export when the payload names no model. That clear is deliberate (#1377, so a stale model from an earlier start is not left in force; `test_host_model_stale_reset_clears_via_env_file`), but a start event without a model (headless builders; compact or resume events) then blanks a good value or never sets one. `seat_map.py compose --host-model ""` reads unknown, falls back to the Claude host family, and keeps every Claude-family seat off the panel with a `host-model-unknown` degradation.
- The invariant: the host model the panel composes against is the model the session is actually running on, from the best record available (the start event when it names one, else the session's own transcript, whose assistant turns record the model); `host-model-unknown` fires only when no record names one. A stale model from an earlier start must still never stand in for the live one. Where the fallback reads, and how the reader finds this session's transcript, is your call; say why, and park with a builder note if no reliable path exists.

DoD:
- A session whose start event names no model, but whose transcript records one, composes its panel against that model (no `host-model-unknown`); test it on a recorded payload and transcript shape.
- A session whose start event names a model that differs from an earlier start still uses the new one (the #1377 stale-reset intent holds; existing tests keep passing or are rewritten with the reason stated).
- A session with no record anywhere still reads unknown and discloses it, as today.
- Bite-proof: drop the fallback and the no-model test goes red.
- TRANSITION under `## Unreleased` says panels keep their Claude seats when a start event omits the model.
